title: His birth name and how he became Preston Jackson
summary: Christened James Preston MacDonald; his mother remarried bricklayer Charles Jackson and he took the Jackson name.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well, I was christened James Preston MacDonald. But you see, my mother and father separated, about three years old. So my mother remarried Charles Jackson, he was a brick major. And so I take the name of Jackson, I used my middle name Preston. His name was Charles Jackson. Yeah.
I noticed Preston J. Jackson when you signed it.

Yeah, I used that J because James was my first name. So it just twisted around a bit, Preston J. I'm better known, it's only the people that I attended school with know me back down. But I'm known professionally as Preston Jackson.
